correctness.rationale: After left-translation each mask lies in the generated dihedral subgroup of index \(q=|H|/\operatorname{ord}(h)\), and the regular operator is q identical copies. For all complex nonzero a,b,c,d the exact Fourier-block determinant is \(ac\,t^2+b(a+c)t+(a-c)^2+b^2-d^2\), with ac,d nonzero. At most two distinct cyclotomic trace roots arise; endpoint roots contribute one kernel direction, other roots contribute two. Exact constructions for any two distinct prescribed roots, including opposite roots, attain every stated packet. The two-/sixfold progression support-incidence proof is complete. Symbolic identity, 44 independently assembled regular matrices, and eleven small-group support censuses replayed successfully, supporting but not replacing universal reasoning.

value.rationale: A natural exact four-point progression plus one reflection has a complete coefficient-sensitive invertibility/rank classification over all generalized dihedral groups. The step order causes an exact three-to-four maximal-nullity packet transition at order five, and subgroup index scales every possible packet; the theorem also counts all affected supports without overcounting. These are meaningful support-geometry and arithmetic recovery obstructions beyond cardinality uncertainty, and not just individual finite numerical samples. No conditioning theorem is asserted.
